title: Kiss: Psycho Circus - The Nightmare Child
text:
Kiss: Psycho Circus - The Nightmare Child is a first person shooter based on Todd McFarlane's Kiss: Psycho Circus series of comic books.

Story
The story tells about a group of four people who receive superhuman powers to fight evil forces. The Kiss members were the four Gods, each of them has cursed one human being to be in the Psycho Circus forever. The game tells a different story about four characters who begin as common human beings. The mysterious Madame Raven guides the playable characters and gives them knowledge to fight mysterious creatures from the cursed Circus and the Nightmare Child itself.
